# Release 1.25 — Stance × Strategy L2

**Status:** Outline — freeze when 1.24 ships  
**Milestone:** `1.25`  
**Parent strategy:** [Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md](../Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md)  
**Architecture source of truth:** [../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md](../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md)  
**Rule:** Do not edit this file to mark done or change scope after `Approved for freeze`. Status → GitHub only.

---

## Outcome

Strategy Lab outputs from releases **1.14–1.17** (candlestick patterns, indicator strategies, Python strategy plugins, backtests) can feed the Stance Engine as **additional evidence** and as a user-selectable **strategy-aligned stance mode**. Default house L1 scorecard remains available. Labels still come from deterministic merger rules — not from LLM.

---

## Locked decisions

| Decision | Choice | Agent implication |
|----------|--------|-------------------|
| Composition | L2 **composes** with L1; does not replace contract | Same JSON contract + `strategy_context` |
| Modes | (1) Default house L1 (2) Strategy-aligned mode | User toggle; both documented |
| Cost | Local compute only | No paid backtest cloud |
| Authority | Merger rules decide final `label` | Strategies contribute signals/scores + evidence bullets |
| Missing strategy data | Omit `strategy_context`; fall back to L1 | Do not invent backtest stats |
| Plugins | Reuse 1.16 trust boundary (AST/subprocess patterns analogous to screen plugins) | Do not `exec` unvalidated code in-request without isolation |

### `strategy_context` (when mode active)

Include at least:

- `strategy_id` / name  
- `signal` (e.g. bullish/bearish/neutral)  
- `backtest_summary` (CAGR, max drawdown, window) when 1.17 data exists  
- `as_of`  
- `disclaimer`: research/simulation, not a guarantee  

---

## Foundation

- [ ] StrategyLab module exposes a read API of latest signals/backtest summaries for an instrument  
- [ ] Stance merger documents how strategy signals adjust or override L1 thresholds  
- [ ] Engine version distinguishes L1-only vs L1+L2 merger packs  
- [ ] UI clearly labels which mode produced the stance

- [ ] Wire pattern flags (1.14) as evidence bullets when present  
- [ ] Wire plugin strategy outputs (1.16) when user selects that strategy  
- [ ] Include backtest stats (1.17) in `strategy_context` when available

---

## Out of scope

- LLM prose (1.26)  
- Changing 1.14–1.17 product scope  
- Live trading based on signals  
- Auto-running all plugins on every page view without caching  

---

## Exit

User can view default L1 stance and a strategy-aligned stance with `strategy_context` filled from Strategy Lab stored/computed outputs; merger rules and versions are documented; no LLM required.

---

## Agent planning instructions

1. Hard-depend on 1.23; soft-depend on completeness of 1.14–1.17 — ship with whatever strategy surfaces exist, honest empty otherwise.  
2. Prefer under free-tier pressure: if 1.14–1.17 incomplete, **defer 1.25** rather than fake signals (see evaluation §7.4 priority: Tier A + 1.11 + watchlists + L1 first).  
3. Do not let strategy plugins write portfolio trades.  
4. One issue per checkbox; milestone `1.25`.
